title: Attractive, has strong smell inside.
text:
Attractive, has strong smell inside.. This is a cute addition to the living area. It can hold magazines, books or small pillow or throws. The design is attractive and can go with any decor.

I didn't give it 5 stars because it smells a little funny. I have no idea what they are putting into products these days that makes the items smell so strong, but I don't like it and it takes forever to get rid of the smell.

product_metadata.title: FIRST HILL FHW Endora Rectangular Fabric Storage Ottoman with Script-Style Pattern - Storm Grey
features: Rectangular-shaped storage ottoman for use as a footrest and/or storage; ideal for a living room, study, or bedroom
Padded lid hinges open for access to ample interior storage space—holds anything from books and games to extra throws
Elegant script-style fabric upholstery in dark grey and white; antique-look nail-head trim along the base
4 slightly flared legs in an accenting dark color provide reliable strength and stability
Measures 16 by 32 by 18 inches (LxWxH); minimal assembly required
description: Classic form and stylish function unit in this rectangular-shaped storage ottoman from First Hill. Ideal for a living room, home office, study, or bedroom, the versatile ottoman works well for extra storage or as a footrest when kicking back with a bestseller.
